content:
{'text': '今年四月，OpenAI 推出咗一款升級版嘅圖像生成技術，名為 ChatGPT Images 2。五個月後，呢間公司而家再發佈強化版本 ChatGPT Images 2.5。', 'source': 'In April of this year, OpenAI launched an upgraded image generation technology called ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company is now releasing an enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.'}

{'text': '相比公司之前嘅圖像生成工具，ChatGPT Images 2 代表住一個重大飛躍。', 'source': "Compared to the company's previous image generation tools, ChatGPT Images 2 represented a significant leap forward."}

{'text': '佢引入咗 2K 解像度輸出、支援多種長寬比，以及透過網絡搜尋擷取最新資訊嘅功能。Images 2 亦加強咗對非拉丁語言系統嘅支援，並提供兩個智能等級：Instant 同 Thinking。', 'source': 'It introduced 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to pull up-to-date information through web search. Images 2 also strengthened support for non-Latin language systems and offered two intelligence levels: Instant and Thinking.'}

{'text': '新版本 Images 2.5 聚焦於「更銳利嘅細節、更快嘅生成速度、更精準嘅編輯，以及更精緻嘅創作同分享工具」。', 'source': 'The new version, Images 2.5, focuses on "sharper details, faster generation, more precise edits, and more polished creation and sharing tools."'}

{'text': 'OpenAI 表示：「Images 2.5 帶嚟更自然嘅光線、更豐富嘅質感、對參考圖像中主體更高嘅還原度，以及喺多輪對話中更可靠地遵循編輯指示。」', 'source': 'OpenAI states: "Images 2.5 brings more natural lighting, richer textures, higher fidelity to subjects in reference images, and more reliable adherence to editing instructions across multiple turns of conversation."'}

{'text': '「相比 Images 2.0，我哋亦將圖像生成延遲減少高達 50%，令你可以更快生成圖像並完善你嘅構思。」', 'source': '"Compared to Images 2.0, we have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50%, allowing you to generate images and refine your ideas more quickly."'}

{'text': '此外，呢間公司詳細介紹咗一個全新嘅「Sketch（草圖）」功能，畀用戶可以直接喺 ChatGPT 內繪圖，並將呢啲繪圖作為圖像生成嘅參考。OpenAI 亦正推出熱門圖像格式嘅範本，以及一個提示詞分享功能，畀其他人可以試用你嘅圖像生成意念，仲有其他新功能。', 'source': 'Additionally, the company detailed a brand-new "Sketch" feature that allows users to draw directly within ChatGPT and use these drawings as references for image generation. OpenAI is also rolling out templates for popular image formats, as well as a prompt-sharing feature that lets others try out your image generation ideas, among other new functions.'}

{'text': '同時，OpenAI 正為開發者提供兩個版本嘅 Images 2.5，協助佢哋將相關功能整合到應用程式入面。GPT-Image-2.5 Flare 同 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst 將透過 OpenAI 嘅 API 提供：', 'source': "Meanwhile, OpenAI is offering two versions of Images 2.5 for developers to help integrate the features into applications. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be available through OpenAI's API:"}

{'text': 'GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare 將同等嘅品質、編輯同速度改良帶到 API 之上。呢個係大多數應用程式嘅推薦選擇，圖像品質比 GPT‑Image‑2 更高，但延遲低 50%。佢適用於廣泛嘅使用場景，由創作者同社交媒體內容、產品體驗、視覺搜尋，以至快速圖像原型設計同大規模生成。GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst 專為需要更精準編輯控制嘅高端視覺工作流程而設計，非常適合創意同編輯工作流程，例如製作廣告素材或修飾過嘅產品圖像。', 'source': 'GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings equivalent improvements in quality, editing, and speed to the API. It is the recommended choice for most applications, delivering higher image quality than GPT‑Image‑2 but with 50% lower latency. It is suited for a broad range of use cases, from creator and social media content, product experiences, and visual search, to rapid image prototyping and large-scale generation. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for high-end visual workflows that require more precise editing control, making it ideal for creative and editorial workflows such as producing advertising assets or retouched product images.'}

{'text': 'OpenAI 表示：「Images 2.5 將由今日起喺桌面版、手機版同網頁版陸續推出，畀所有等級嘅 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 同 Codex 用戶使用。」想了解更多關於新圖像生成技術嘅資訊，請瀏覽呢度。', 'source': 'OpenAI states: "Images 2.5 will begin rolling out starting today on desktop, mobile, and web for ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users across all tiers." To learn more about the new image generation technology, visit here.'}

{'text': 'ChatGPT Images 2.5 嘅推出，係喺上週發佈 GPT-6 Astra 之後。', 'source': "The launch of ChatGPT Images 2.5 follows last week's release of GPT-6 Astra."}
